headline: Hydration tracker fixes
intro: Polish for the hydration panel, live preview, and Twitch reward wiring.

features.title: Floating hydration panel
features.body: The hydration dashboard opens as a floating widget (like other tools) so your deck layout stays put while you tune settings.

features.title: 1920×1080 preview & overlay URL
features.body: The in-panel preview matches your OBS browser source size, and Copy gives a real localhost hydration URL with the same control as other overlays.
